## Checklist

- [ ] The base branch is right: `develop` for a feature, `main` only for a release or an urgent fix
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `php artisan test` passes
- [ ] `vendor/bin/pint` has been run
- [ ] New screens show only the records of the branch chosen in the branch switcher
- [ ] Database changes are new migrations; existing columns are not changed
